lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: First one out of the 2025 envelope. And it's a real Gerry's Percentages. Canadian teams, second round. How many of them win a series.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: G-E-R-R-Y. Somebody had to say it.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Now this one's from May, not September. May 6. You remember where we were, Dog? Leafs had just taken game 1 from Florida the night before. Oilers were dropping the puck in Vegas that night. Jets and Dallas the next day. Three Canadian teams in the second round. Three.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: Three. And the whole country doing math. I said it then, Hayesy. The Leafs don't deserve the benefit of the doubt in May. Not after the last 10 years.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: And Nick, at 6:29 in the evening, puts a board up. 0 teams, 15%. 1 team, 75%. 2 teams, 25%. 3, 0%.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: That's a man who brought a spreadsheet to a campfire. Team Corsi. I respect it, and I hate it.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: He gave it 115%, Hayesy. That's not a board, that's a motivational poster.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Chris said 2. Leafs and Oilers. Justin said 1 or 2, 50/50. And Jay said 3.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: THREE! Jay had the Jets, the Leafs AND the Oilers all winning a round. In the same spring. Buddy.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: The answer. 1. Oilers beat Vegas. Leafs lost game 7 to Florida. Jets lost to Dallas. 1.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: Of COURSE the Leafs lost a game 7. Cue Hello Darkness. 95% of the time, possibly higher, that's how it ends.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Nick had 75% on 1. Nick takes the W. Justin, 50/50. That's not a number, that's a shrug. Everybody else, L.
